The book covers part of this question:

Gender Equality in Islam
Gender equality is a fundamental principle in Islam, emphasizing the equal rights and responsibilities of men and women in all aspects of life. Ronald Inglehart and Pippa Norris write that the social values of gender equality and sexual liberalization could plausibly lie at the heart of any 'clash' between Islam and the west. [1]
The social values of gender equality and sexual liberalization are central to understanding the differences between Islamic and Western societies. Ronald Inglehart and Pippa Norris write that the social values of gender equality and sexual liberalization could plausibly lie at the heart of any 'clash' between Islam and the west. [1]

Not covered in this book
· The extent to which gender equality is enshrined in Islamic law and practice.
· The role of religious institutions in promoting gender equality.
· The impact of historical and cultural factors on gender equality in Islamic societies.
